comparisons.peer_summary: International sales accounted for 66% of net revenue in 2024 (65% in 2023) and are expected to remain significant; substantially all sales transactions are denominated in U.S. dollars.
comparisons.comparison: While AVGO specifically breaks out its geographic revenue dependency on China (20% in 2024), AMD reports general international sales percentage (66% in 2024) without isolating China exposure. AVGO notes that its China shipment percentage overstates end-customer dependency because products are often shipped via China-based partners to end customers elsewhere, whereas AMD's disclosure focuses on the aggregate international volume and currency denomination without a similar geographic nuance regarding end-user location vs. shipping origin.

sentences.text: In fiscal years 2024 and 2023, 20% and 32%, respectively, of our net revenue came from shipments or deliveries to China (including Hong Kong).

As a result, we believe that a substantially smaller percentage of our net revenue is ultimately dependent on sales of either our product or our customers' product incorporating our product, to end customers located in China (including Hong Kong).
International sales as a percentage of net revenue were 66% in 2024 and 65% in 2023.
Substantially all of our sales transactions are denominated in U.S. dollars.

peer_results.rationale: Retrieved candidates focus on customer concentration (top 3 customers) and general sales channels (OEMs/ODMs), which do not address the specific topic of geographic revenue dependency on China or the distinction between shipment location and end-customer location present in the target disclosure.

comparisons.peer_summary: 2023 was characterized by weak demand in many end markets due to macroeconomic challenges and inventory reductions, leading to significant drops in average selling prices for DRAM and NAND, as well as revenue declines across all segments.
comparisons.comparison: Both companies disclose significant exposure to the Chinese market, but the nature of the risk differs. AVGO reports that 20% of its 2024 net revenue came from shipments to China, citing a distribution model where end customers may be located elsewhere. In contrast, MU discloses a specific regulatory risk in China where the Cyberspace Administration (CAC) determined its products presented a cybersecurity risk, restricting purchases by critical information infrastructure operators, implying a direct operational barrier rather than just a revenue concentration metric.

sentences.text: In fiscal years 2024 and 2023, 20% and 32%, respectively, of our net revenue came from shipments or deliveries to China (including Hong Kong).

As a result, we believe that a substantially smaller percentage of our net revenue is ultimately dependent on sales of either our product or our customers' product incorporating our product, to end customers located in China (including Hong Kong).
Also in 2023, China's Cyberspace Administration (the "CAC") conducted a cybersecurity review of our products sold in China and decided that our products presented a cybersecurity risk.
The CAC determined that critical information infrastructure operators in China may not purchase Micron products.

comparisons.peer_summary: Revenue from customers outside the United States accounted for 56% of total revenue in fiscal year 2024 and 69% in fiscal year 2023, with geographic designation based on billing location.
comparisons.comparison: AVGO and NVDA both disclose geographic revenue concentration, but they use different methodologies for attribution. AVGO assigns revenue to China based on the geographic shipment or delivery location specified by customers, noting this may overstate actual end-customer dependency because products often ship through China to end customers elsewhere. NVDA explicitly states its geographic revenue designation is based on the billing location, which may also differ from the end customer's location, but does not provide a specific percentage for China or discuss the extent of China-specific shipment dependencies like AVGO does.

sentences.text: Although we recognize revenue for the majority of our products when title and control transfer in Penang, Malaysia, we disclose net revenue by country based primarily on the geographic shipment or delivery location specified by our distributors, OEMs, contract manufacturers, channel partners, or software customers.
In fiscal years 2024 and 2023, 20% and 32%, respectively, of our net revenue came from shipments or deliveries to China (including Hong Kong).
Revenue by geographic region is designated based on the billing location even if the revenue may be attributable to end customers, such as enterprises and gamers in a different location.
Revenue from sales to customers outside of the United States accounted for 56% and 69% of total revenue for fiscal years 2024 and 2023, respectively.
